description: We are Earth's detectives! Two Puerto Rican students who want to use technology and data to identify patterns in Earth's systems and help create solutions to conserve our natural resources.
summary: ESTRACE is an app that uses NASA data and Machine Learning to identify, visualize and analyze environmental changes in atmospheric temperatures and oceans over a period of time. Through a simple and friendly interface, users can select a variety of environmental variables, regions, and time periods to explore trends through graphs and statistics. This app, made for students, researchers, and Earth enthusiasts, is the first step toward exploration projects, identifying patterns and how they may affect our daily lives. ESTRACE helps determine what is changing, where is it changing, whether those changes are significant and provide tools to predict possible future trends in climate change and global warming. This project explores the connection between atmospheric and oceanic systems, especially the role of temperatures in the sea surface and deep ocean ecosystems and species.
details:
Description and Features:

ESTRACE is a data and trend visualization tool focused on atmospheric and ocean systems. It has a simple and user-friendly interface and design, inspired by the climate change stripes. It has two main features: the data visualization page, where users can retrieve data and organize through region, time period, and resolution. They can visualize changes over time, save projects, compare with other datasets, and run a statistical analysis with data they can download. Our second feature is the prediction tool, where users can select their projects and run a prediction model with machine learning for 5, 10, and 20 years. They can also observe daily life implications and effects on other Earth systems.

Considerations:

When developing this app, we considered different factors such as the number of datasets. We decided to limit the number of variables to seven because of time constraints; we also wanted to have the app working without problems, and keeping a small number of datasets for this first version would help us on it. Additionally, we wanted to have a useful interface which is easy to navigate. We used Base44 to develop the app, but always checked and troubleshooted to make sure that everything was working correctly.

Impact:

ESTRACE can have a great impact on solving this challenge by connecting different Earth systems and discovering patterns, leading to new projects on these topics. Additionally, it may motivate students to explore data visualization and study in these fields thanks to the simplicity of the app. Through ESTRACE, we hope to inspire multidisciplinary research to solve Earth's greatest mysteries combining existing tools for a better planet.
